name: PivotTables
description: A collection of all the PivotTable objects in the specified workbook.
remarks: Because PivotTable report programming can be complex, it's generally easiest to record PivotTable report actions and then revise the recorded code.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or index number for the object.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(PivotCache As PivotCache, TableDestination As Variant, [TableName As Variant], [ReadData As Variant], [DefaultVersion As Variant]) As PivotTable
methods.description: Adds a new PivotTable report. Returns a PivotTable object.

parameters.name: PivotCache
parameters.description: The PivotTable cache on which the new PivotTable report is based. The cache provides data for the report.

parameters.name: TableDestination
parameters.description: The cell in the upper-left corner of the PivotTable report's destination range (the range on the worksheet where the resulting report will be placed). You must specify a destination range on the worksheet that contains the PivotTables object specified by _expression_.

parameters.name: TableName
parameters.description: The name of the new PivotTable report.

parameters.name: ReadData
parameters.description: True to create a PivotTable cache that contains all records from the external database; this cache can be very large. False to enable setting some of the fields as server-based page fields before the data is actually read.

parameters.name: DefaultVersion
parameters.description: The version of Microsoft Excel that the PivotTable was originally created in.
